name: Versus Incident
description: Incident gateway with an AI SRE agent that learns normal log patterns, flags anomalies, and routes alerts to chat and on-call tools.
whatItDoes: Accepts alerts over webhooks and forwards formatted notifications to Slack, Teams, Telegram, Viber, email or Lark, with escalation to on-call systems. Its agent watches logs to learn what is normal and raise incidents when behaviour deviates.
howItWorks: A Go service exposes a gateway endpoint and templated notification channels, backed by Redis. The agent runs in training, shadow or detect mode so teams can build a baseline before letting it alert. On-call hand-off goes to PagerDuty, Opsgenie, incident.io or ServiceNow.

requirements.name: Docker
requirements.description: Runs from a published container image

requirements.name: SLACK_TOKEN
requirements.description: Bot token when Slack notifications are enabled, together with SLACK_CHANNEL_ID

run: docker run -p 3000:3000 -e GATEWAY_SECRET=change-me -e AGENT_ENABLE=true -e AGENT_MODE=training -e REDIS_HOST=host.docker.internal -e REDIS_PORT=6379 -v $(pwd)/config:/app/config -v $(pwd)/data:/app/data ghcr.io/versuscontrol/versus-incident
models: Not stated in the README; see project docs
